name: session-guardian
description: Detect oversized Codex tasks and safely continue them in a compact replacement task.

interface.shortDescription: Roll oversized tasks into compact handoffs.
interface.longDescription: Monitors Codex task size locally, blocks oversized prompts before execution, and safely asks Codex to continue in a summarized replacement before archiving the original.
defaultPrompt: Check whether this task is getting too large.
Roll this task over now and preserve the handoff.
